QUOTE: "The library creates no threads." and "Enabling `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` adds: Global mutexes: `mbedtls_threading_key_slot_mutex`... Per-object mutexes initialised in each `*_init()`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads. It also says `library/threading.c` supplies the mutex layer, either pthread-based or an ALT hook, that the library's modules use for threaded callers. It frames that layer as compiled out by default, but it still states both halves.
